$comment: DATA-TABLED TTL policy for the accounting-registry (pillar-G resource-class budgets; PHASE-0-FIREWALL-PLAN §5.1 + 10-gates-registry §A.3). Keyed by unit_class so every row in the registry resolves a ttl WITHOUT a scanner branch. Closed action enum: report|review-for-retirement. The gate never moves or deletes repository content; review-for-retirement is a non-actuating signal for a separately reviewed deletion from candidate HEAD with predecessor Git object OID and digest receipts. Protected classes use report only. budget_days:null = no expiry (protected / authoritative classes). This same table is emitted verbatim as ttl-policy.generated.json (Gate-3 companion face).
